Measurement-only gallery. Predictions below used a 120-second diagnostic allowance. Production budgets remain 1100 ms inside the model service, 1200 ms for n8n's model call and a 3000 ms controller Verdict Window. The diagnostic allowance cannot approve production timing.

All native boxes are shown; no confidence filtering. 24 previously unsubmitted held-out original images, shared across 32 image/defect conditions with three repeats each. No held-out tuning. This small test is not a production-accuracy estimate. Every condition currently requires human review.
